Integrates with file/path validation from Story 006.0 and contributes to REQ-DEEP-CACHE. - loadAndCacheRequirements: fs.readFileSync(story, "utf8"), scans content with /REQ-[A-Z0-9-]+/g, stores all matches in a Map<string, Set> cache keyed by resolved path. On any error it catches and caches an empty Set. This implements markdown-content parsing independent of structure (REQ-DEEP-PARSE, REQ-DEEP-FORMAT, REQ-DEEP-SECTION) and per-Program caching (REQ-DEEP-CACHE, Error Handling AC by not crashing on I/O errors). - checkRequirementExists: checks reqSet.has(reqId); if false, reports reqMissing with { reqId, storyPath } (REQ-DEEP-MATCH, REQ-DEEP-ERROR). - extractReqIdFromLine: parses @req lines into IDs (REQ-DEEP-PARSE of annotation format). - resolveStoryAndRequirements: composes validateAndResolveStoryPath + loadAndCacheRequirements and returns { resolvedStoryPath, reqSet }, centralizing path validation + caching (Integration AC). - parseImplementsLine / validateImplementsLine: support "@supports " lines, parsing storyPath and requirement IDs, resolving story path and validating each ID against the cached Set. This provides deep validation for multi-requirement, multi-story @supports usage (contributes to REQ-DEEP-FORMAT and Integration AC, and aligns with Story 010.2-DEV-MULTI-STORY-SUPPORT). - processAllComments / createValidReqReferenceProgramVisitor: iterate all comments via sourceCode.getAllComments(), track current @story path, dispatch @req and @supports lines for validation while reusing a per-Program reqCache. This wires deep validation cleanly into existing annotation parsing logic (Integration AC, REQ-DEEP-CACHE).,Requirement formats and story-file structures (Quality Standards AC, REQ-DEEP-FORMAT, REQ-DEEP-SECTION): loadAndCacheRequirements uses regex /REQ-[A-Z0-9-]+/g over the entire markdown file, without depending on headings, sections, bullet vs numbered lists, or checkboxes. This means any occurrence of tokens like REQ-FOO-BAR in: - Plain lines - Bullet lists (e.g., "- REQ-BULLET-LIST - ...") - Numbered lists - Acceptance-criteria checkboxes is detected uniformly. Fixtures confirm support for at least bullet-list formats: - tests/fixtures/story_bullet.md defines a "## Requirements" section with list items "- REQ-BULLET-LIST - ..." and "- REQ-ANOTHER - ..."; tests show deep validation correctly recognizing these IDs. Additional fixtures (story_multi_a.md, story_multi_b.md) use bullet lists with shared and unique IDs, and deep validation behaves as expected. These tests confirm both deep content validation and the clarity/specificity of error messages (User Experience AC, REQ-DEEP-ERROR).,Error handling behavior (Error Handling AC, REQ-DEEP-ERROR): loadAndCacheRequirements wraps fs.readFileSync in try/catch and, on any error (missing file, permission issue, malformed content), sets an empty Set in the cache rather than throwing. validateReqLine/validateImplementsLine short-circuit if storyPath is null/invalid or if resolveStoryAndRequirements returns null reqSet. traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria for Story 010.0-DEV-DEEP-VALIDATION are satisfied. The valid-req-reference rule and its helpers implement deep requirement-content validation by parsing referenced story files, caching and reusing discovered requirement IDs, and matching @req and @supports references against those sets. The implementation supports varied markdown structures and list formats, integrates with existing annotation and file-validation rules, provides clear and specific error messages for missing requirements and invalid paths, handles I/O and content issues without crashing, and is documented with concrete examples. Dedicated tests tied to this story pass, and the broader test suite confirms correct integration across the plugin. Therefore the story is fully implemented and in a passing state.
